items.title: Agnico Eagle Bets on Massive Gold Expansion Despite Rising Mining Costs
items.summary: Agnico Eagle Mines (NYSE: AEM) is targeting a 20%–30% increase in annual gold production into the 2030s, backed by four major projects that could add between 1.3 million and 1.5 million ounces of annual output.

items.title: Stanley Druckenmiller and 10 Other Big Funds Bought Newmont Last Quarter. Ken Fisher and 5 Others Sold. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 11 bought Newmont and 6 sold, with Stanley Druckenmiller’s Duquesne Family Office opening new stakes in Newmont, Agnico Eagle and Barrick. Most of the sellers trimmed.

items.title: Avantis U.S. Large Cap Value ETF (AVLV) Adds AT&T and Micron on Tuesday
items.summary: The fund bought $227.7 million of stock, lifting 162 positions and selling none, with AT&T and Micron leading the buys.

items.title: Holding GLD For Stock Falls? Gold Missed This One
items.summary: SPDR Gold Shares (GLD) rose in 6 of the 9 S&P 500 falls of 10% or more since the fund began in November 2004. This fall, gold did not help. GLD lost 14.3% from the S&P 500's October 6 record through November 25.

items.title: How Much Can Newmont Stock Make You From Here?
items.summary: Newmont closed at $100.73 on Monday, November 23, well below its August 25 high of $135.14. The gold miner is back where it bounced before. If you bought it today and it bounced again, how much money could you make.

items.title: Gold Is Down 35%—Is the Bull Case Broken or Just Bruised?
items.summary: Gold has fallen roughly 35% from its January 2026 record amid rate hikes, pressuring GLD and Newmont, though central bank buying and analyst price targets suggest the bull case persists.
